literal: Yearningly guarding, let one protect right conduct; even if one examines and carefully investigates, that indeed is the support.
translation: One should protect right conduct with great effort and care; for even if one thoroughly investigates and searches all paths, that alone is the ultimate support.
modern: வருந்தியும் போற்றியும் ஒழுக்கத்தைக் காக்க வேண்டும்; ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்துத் தெளிந்தாலும், அந்த ஒழுக்கமே நமக்குச் சிறந்த துணையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the supreme importance of maintaining right conduct (ஒழுக்கம்). The author advises that one must protect their conduct with earnest effort (பரிந்து) and constant vigilance (ஓம்பி). Even if one thoroughly investigates and analyzes various philosophies or means of life (தெரிந்து தேரினும்), they will find that right conduct is the only true and reliable support (துணை) in life. The repetition of protective terms highlights the intense care required to preserve one's character.
